name: Roll Safe
look: A video still of actor Kayode Ewumi as Roll Safe, a young Black man in a black leather jacket and gold watch, smiling slyly and tapping his temple with one finger as if he has a clever idea. A shop's chalkboard sign stands behind him.
use: The captions offer a flawed genius life hack, where the logic technically works but misses the point, such as avoiding a problem by simply never doing the thing at all.
examples: You can't be late for work
if you never leave the house
if you just eat the bread
